An evolving record of work, thoughts and questions as I work through the 2026 Virtual Cell Challenge.
I am joining the challenge to learn and writing this to clarify my own thoughts[^writing-to-learn] and share useful information I find along the way.

* Disclaimer I: I am learning much of this material on the fly.
* Disclaimer II: I am/was a physicist, so some of the material may be quite mathy.
* Disclaimer III: I will use AI tools for a lot of the coding so proceed with caution there.
All of the prose will be bashed out by these fingers though (with a bit of copyediting help).

I hope you enjoy the read.

[^writing-to-learn]: William Zinsser, [*Writing to Learn*](https://www.harpercollins.com/products/writing-to-learn-william-zinsser) (1988), makes the case that writing about a subject is one of the best ways to understand it.
